essence: Heart withheld from yoginī-born and Rudra; swift yoga-release.
Right utterance: host face to face, body-possession-marked.
Moment remembered in kiss, navel-sealed: binds body and host.
Asked tells past-future; within a watch, god-form uttered.
Undoubted seen, Rudra-drawn; two watches, sky-standing.
By three: mothers, heroes, perfected, śākinī-host gather.
Come, pledged, urged: supreme fruit, whatever wished.
By this the perfected perfect; mantra-men effected.
All in tantra succeeds; mantra-power, no controller.

rasa.justification: Wonder at exhibited efficacy — withheld heart, face-to-face host, past-future told, mothers gathering — braced by vīra: the powers are not admired but wielded (bound, effected, succeeded).

sections.BOUNDARY: No fruit is tasted; knowing begins beyond the powers.
sections.EXPLANATION: Exclusion (neither yoginī-born nor Rudra plainly gets the swift-releasing heart). Utterance rightly made: great host face to face, body-marked. Memory a moment in the kiss, navel-sealed: binds body and host. Asked tells past-future; within a watch, meant god-form uttered. Undoubted seen, Rudra-drawn; two watches, sky-standing, remembering. By three the mothers — heroes, perfected, śākinī-host — come, pledged, urged: supreme fruit, whatever wished. By this the perfected perfect; mantra-men effected. All in Bhairava-tantra succeeds from this: mantra-potency power, no controller.
sections.FUNCTION: Demonstrates the heart's efficacy: exclusion, utterance, memory, vision, host, success.
sections.KEY TERMS: hṛdaya (heart of god of gods — withheld); sanmukhatā (face-to-faceness); cumbaka (kiss — Vivaraṇa collation open); prahara (watch — speed measured); śākinīgaṇa (host gathered); niyantṛ (controller — denied, mantra works itself).
sections.LOCAL CONTEXT: Powers pledged in the opening question are exhibited here before fruit is tasted.
sections.RELATED: Khecarī-mudrā kiss hypothesis open; no-controller clause (efficacy without human manager).
sections.SUMMARY: Withheld from yoginī-born and Rudra alike, the heart gives swift release. Rightly uttered, the host stands face to face, body-marked. Remembered a moment in the kiss, navel-sealed: binds body and host. Asked, past and future told; within a watch, the god-form uttered. Undoubted seen, Rudra-drawn; two watches, sky-standing. By three the mothers gather — heroes, perfected, śākinī-host; come, pledged, urged: supreme fruit, whatever wished. By this the perfected perfect, mantra-men made; all in tantra succeeds by mantra-power, no controller.
